ITEM 1 | Square-cut flatbread-style slices, two pieces, golden-tan crust with browned spots and dark char marks on edges, topped with melted pale cheese and red tomato sauce patches, slightly glossy where cheese melted; each slice roughly 7 x 4 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, lower-left of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale golden-tan grains, small granular texture, loosely clumped, with a single halved cherry-red tomato piece with visible seeds and dull skin on top, sitting at upper right of the plate; scattered loose grains around the edge | 75
ITEM 3 | Sliced brown-pink meat, medium-brown seared exterior with darker crust and fibrous grain, some pinkish interior visible, a few small dark fragments at the base, moist surface with slight sheen, cut into overlapping slices about 9 x 5 cm, sitting beside the grains and above the flatbread | 95
